name: app-6aba19886fd8819190c14403ef902f5c
description: Enkio: an AI visual creation suite. It connects to enkiomv.ai through the remote gx-mcp MCP service to create music videos from audio and images, animate a single image, create first-to-last-frame transitions, generate videos from multiple reference images, generate videos from text prompts, and create or edit images with text prompts (text-to-image / image-to-image).

interface.longDescription: Enkio connects to enkiomv.ai's AI visual creation tools: upload audio and images to generate a story, cover, character designs, storyboard, and final music video; animate a single image; create smooth first-to-last-frame transitions; combine multiple reference images into a new video; generate a video from a text prompt without source media; and create or edit images by changing style, background, or details with a prompt.
defaultPrompt: Create a music video from this song and these photos
Turn this photo into a 5-second video
Generate an image from this prompt
